summary: Sets the pre-interval and post-interval extend conditions for CHOP channels without changing the channel interval length.

key_params.name: left
key_params.note: Extend behavior before the CHOP interval

key_params.name: right
key_params.note: Extend behavior after the CHOP interval

key_params.name: mirror
key_params.note: Repeat while mirroring every other cycle

key_params.name: default
key_params.note: Use Default Value outside the interval

key_params.name: defval
key_params.note: Value used when Default Value extend mode is active

key_concepts: Sets CHOP extend conditions, which determine sampled values before or after the channel interval.
Left Behavior and Right Behavior are independent, so pre-interval and post-interval sampling can use different modes.
Official extend modes are No Change, Hold, Slope, Cycle, Mirror, and Default Value.
Default Value only affects regions whose behavior is set to Default Value.
Extend CHOP does not shorten or lengthen the actual interval; Trim CHOP is the official tool for interval start/end edits.
Current extend conditions can be inspected from a CHOP's pop-up info.
common_gotchas: Extend CHOP changes sampling behavior before and after the interval; it does not trim or lengthen the interval itself.
Use Trim CHOP when the start or end of the CHOP interval needs to change.
Default Value has no effect unless left or right behavior is set to Default Value.
Cycle and mirror behavior depends on a meaningful input interval; single-sample or empty-feeling inputs may not loop as expected.
Middle-click a CHOP to inspect its current extend conditions.
